name: website_https
description: An Ansible playbook that installs and configures Apache on Ubuntu, serves a static site, and enables HTTPS with a generated self-signed certificate.

name: poodle_fix
description: An Ansible remediation playbook that restricts Apache SSL protocols to TLS 1.2 and restarts the web service.

name: chef-infra-server-bootstrap
description: Bootstraps Chef Infra Server by deploying the server, creating a user and organization, and generating credential PEM files.

name: chef-automate-bootstrap
description: Bootstraps a combined Chef Automate and Chef Infra Server installation, including administrative setup, organization creation, and credential generation.

name: ssh-root-login-compliance
description: Chef InSpec control that verifies SSH root login is disabled and evaluates an alternate package-based security assertion.

name: website-https-compliance
description: Chef InSpec checks that validate HTTPS availability, expected site content, and TLS protocol configuration.
